name: Capacities
tagline: Object-based personal knowledge management with AI assistant
painPoints: Object-based approach requires learning a new mental model for note-taking
Paid Pro plan for AI assistant and unlimited media uploads
AI features are reactive — you query them, they do not proactively surface information
No email or calendar integration for automatic knowledge capture
Still requires manual input for all knowledge — nothing is captured automatically
metaDescription: Looking for a Capacities alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across your tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Capacities introduces a fresh take on personal knowledge management with its object-based approach — instead of hierarchical notes, everything is a typed object (person, book, project) with semantic relationships. The built-in AI chat helps you query your knowledge base. But Capacities still requires you to manually create and maintain every object and note. It has no email integration, no calendar awareness, and no ability to automatically build your knowledge graph from what is already happening in your digital life. Users who want a PKM that learns passively from their activity seek alternatives.
gaiaReplaces: Automatic knowledge graph construction from email and calendar data
Object and entity tracking for people, projects, and topics via AI inference
Proactive knowledge surfacing without manual queries
Meeting and correspondence memory without active note creation
Semantic knowledge retrieval across all connected tools
gaiaAdvantages: Knowledge built automatically from email and calendar: zero manual input
Proactive surfacing: relevant knowledge appears when you need it
Graph-based memory models relationships between entities automatically
Source-available and self-hostable; Capacities is closed-source SaaS
Free tier without object or block limits
migrationSteps: Export your Capacities notes and objects as Markdown or JSON
Import key content into GAIA's memory system for semantic retrieval
Connect Gmail and Google Calendar to begin automatic knowledge enrichment
Use GAIA's conversational interface to query and extend your knowledge base

faqs.question: Does GAIA have Capacities' object-based note structure?
faqs.answer: GAIA's graph-based memory models entities (people, projects, events) and their relationships automatically, similar in spirit to Capacities' object model. The key difference is that GAIA infers these objects from your digital activity rather than requiring you to create them manually.

faqs.question: Is GAIA cheaper than Capacities Pro?
faqs.answer: Capacities Pro is a paid plan. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month but includes email management, calendar integration, task management, and tool connections alongside knowledge management. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs).

faqs.question: Does GAIA have an AI chat for knowledge queries like Capacities?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's conversational interface can query your knowledge base, summarize past discussions, and surface relevant context from memory — similar to Capacities' AI chat but drawing from a richer data source including email and calendar.

faqs.question: Is GAIA source-available where Capacities is not?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial) on GitHub. Capacities is a closed-source SaaS product. With GAIA you can self-host and keep all your knowledge data on your own infrastructure.
